messages:
julia_cs: Kicking off LatticeOn onboarding. Pilot goal: validate SSO, daily export, and cost transparency within ~3 weeks. Need owners + one-line success criteria.

mike_impl: I can own integration (SSO + export). Quick Q: pilot wants SAML only or SAML+SCIM?

tara_eng: From infra: SAML only for pilot. I'll own perf tests and staging. Need sample traffic shape and expected concurrent sessions.

leah_pm: Product success criteria: 1) SSO working with 2 test users, 2) CSV export into their Snowflake schema validated, 3) median chat latency <250ms and embeddings p95 <2s during the 48h pilot. Exec demo must include cost delta vs incumbent.

yusuf_renewals: Renewal note: main risk is uncontrolled token spend. Ill prepare a one-pager for finance showing unit-cost reconciliation.

julia_cs: Proposed owners: Julia (CS), Mike (Integration), Tara (Eng perf), Leah (PM), Yusuf (Renewal). Agree?

mike_impl: Agreed. I'll draft an integration checklist and request IdP metadata + sample CSV rows.

tara_eng: I'll spin up a staging route and run two 24h passes: interactive daytime + overnight batch. Leah, can you send the traffic profile?

leah_pm: Sending traffic profile in a DM. Also LatticeOn will provide prompt samples but want PII redacted  we should offer a small sanitize script.

julia_cs: I'll ask them to redact and offer a script. Quick timeline (WIP):

```
- Day 0: internal owners confirmed + IdP request
- Week 1: SSO setup + baseline capture + quick cost A/B (quantized vs full)
- Week 2: Integration + 48h pilot load window
- Week 3: Tuning + exec demo + handoff + renewal one-pager
```

mike_impl: Note: they use ~6k token prompts in one flow. Tagging "model-variant-eval" to compare cost/quality.

yusuf_renewals: Action items today: Mike - integration doc (EOD); Tara - perf plan + A/B template; Leah - traffic + redaction plan; Julia - request IdP metadata & finance contact. I'll draft renewal brief template.

event-bot: Meeting scheduled: "LatticeOn Internal Onboard Prep" Thu 9am PT  invite sent.

julia_cs: Thanks team 389 I'll consolidate and run the internal sync before customer kickoff.
